notes.title: All the bugs, and all the fixes
notes.content:
What would a content patch be without ALL of the bugs?

[h1][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h1]
[b]- Crit works properly now[/b]
[b]- Robberies and Thievery should now work properly[/b]
[b]- Max level raised to 8, as intended[/b]
[b]- The iron key once again properly unlocks the door it's supposed to[/b]
[b]- Shops now close properly when they are supposed to[/b]
[b]- The potion of Death once again gets added to your inventory when you acquire it[/b]
[b]- You no longer sell both weapons to the shop if they have the same name. Damn Shop code. Every time[/b]
[b]- An assortment of small UI bugs that crashed the game are no longer there[/b]


[h1][b]Changes[/b][/h1]
[b]- Enemies no longer stun you when you are already stunned. Kind of unfair...[/b]
[b]- Stun is slightly shorter.[/b]
[b]- The forest is now available at all levels. It can be used to catch a new sibling up to current content[/b]
[b]- Mage spells do more damage[/b]



[h1][b]That's it for now, though I'm sure there's plenty more to come[/b][/h1]

Probably in the shop...

notes.title: Marburgh 1.0 Release
notes.content:
[h1][b]MARBURGH IS OUT OF EARLY ACCESS![/b][/h1]


[h1][b]Additions[/b][/h1]
- [b]NEW DUNGEON - The cave[/b]
       - Complete with new events and new enemies
- [b]THE FOREST[/b]
       - Venture into the forest to find rewards and glory. Every time you leave your progress is reset
       - Inside you will find a variety of monsters and new encounters.
- [b]YOU CAN NOW FACE UP TO 6 ENEMIES AT A TIME[/b]
- [b]Bartender[/b] - There are now individual bartenders to speak with, and to flirt with.
- [b]Locals[/b] - Stay and gossip, Listen to music, make rousing speeches, and discover secrets
- [b]Jobs[/b] - NPCs now may have tasks for the player to help out with. 
- [b]Robbery/Stealing[/b] - Why give when it's so much more fun to take?
- [b]New Weapons to Create[/b]
- [b]New potions[/b]
- [b]Further weapon balance[/b]
- [b]Multi handed Combat[/b] - You now attack with each individual hand if you are dual wielding
[/list]

[h1][b]Bugfixes[/b][/h1]
- This time it was status indicator that were just straight up messed. Should all be working as intended now
- Various UI improvements






[b]This is my first game release, So I'm pretty stoked. Big thank you to anyone who picked it up or helped test it. [/b]

I do still plan to add to the game, but it won't be a crazy, 6-7 hours a day, 7 days a week thing anymore

notes.title: Upcoming Release - December 26
notes.content:
[h1][b]Marburgh is leaving Early access and releasing December 26th![/b][/h1]

I've gotten a lot of work done over this Christmas break so far, and will be ready to release for Boxing day

[h1][b]Content update[/b][/h1]
For this release I've almost doubled the current content in the game. There are more exploration/dungeon events, more monsters, more Items to build, and plenty more things to do in town. I'm quite Excited.

[h1][b]Price Update[/b][/h1]
I will be updating the price from 3.99$ USD to 4.99$ USD 

[h1][b]Future Updates[/b][/h1]
I really love this game. It's my first, after all. As well, Growing up in the 80s and 90s, I have a weird affinity for this style of text RPG game. As such, I do plan to continue to update it. I have some ideas for expanding the combat arena, more forest events, lots of things. 

I will not, however, be updating at the same pace I currently am.

notes.title: Bug fixes and Changes
notes.content:
Well, It never fails, I add stuff, I break stuff without noticing.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

- Store will no longer take your item but not pay you if you back out of a sale.
- You have [b]10[/b] days to defeat the savage Orc, as the intro says. Somehow it internally got changed to 5.
- 2 handed weapons are now indicated as such in the store
- Status effect Labels on a monster that dies no longer transfer to another monster
- Fixed weird colored brackets in combat
- Rogue can no longer stun a monster forever
- Abilities now cost their listed amount

[b]Changes[/b]

- There are now several countdown updates when you are approaching losing the game because of time.
- Dual wielding now means striking twice.
- Slight increase enemy health
- Slightly larger increase to player damage
- The rend tooltip has been updated
- Slimes are a little less Weirdly generous.
- You find a little extra gold after defeating the first boss
- The Jailer's name is now "The Jailer"

notes.title: The core of the game is here. More to come
notes.content:
[b][h2]Next Big Content Drop is being pushed slightly[/h2][/b]

Turns out, most of what I wanted to add not only isn't supported by my old code, changing it undoes a lot of the original "Spaghetti"

I'm still planning to be done very soon, but most of the past several days has been refactoring.

On the bright side, I've already added/changed quite a bit, which will go live right away

 
[h1][b][h1]RELEASING NOW - Tutorial, Rework, Balance, Bugfix[/h1][/b][/h1]

[b]Tutorial[/b]
The game now has several layers of tutorial, as some people were having trouble figuring out what to do next, or were getting killed quickly in combat. There is a screen after picking a character which goes into greater detail as to how the character works. There is also a COMBAT ARENA now. To begin your adventure in the dungeon you must show your prowess in the arena! The arena will be fleshed out in future patches as a way of earning Prestige, loot and a title.

[b]Rework[/b]
A good chunk of the game has been reworked, in terms of the order in which things happen. There is more of a linear narrative, with a clear direction or what to do next.

[b]Balance[/b]
Lots of balance changes, to the weapons, and especially the monsters. The rework has made it easier to tell where the player SHOULD be at in terms of power at different stages of the game, which means the challenges should be more appropriate

[h1]Bugfix and changes[/h1]
[b]Changes[/b]
- You now gradually unlock Marburgh
- NPCs are now individuals
- Tavern : Can now order drinks
- Tavern: The bartender gives advice based on current goals
- Combat Arena : Tutorial area to learn combat and get starting equipment
- Enhanced Info screens 
- Opponent names changed to give better indication who you are targeting
- When a player dies, Next character gets some compensation to jump back in
- Offhand Weapon now does full damage for rogue, 2/3 damage for Warrior and Mage, up from 1/3 for 
   all.
- Item shop is now open, selling basic potions and basic equipment when no other stores are open.
- You can now Back out of targeting an enemy in combat by pressing 0
- Added color to a bunch of text
- In the store, Damage is the first attribute listed on weapons
- [b]Forest encounters[/b]
   - Right now, there's little to do except find some monsters to help level up. I plan to flesh it out in the next patch. Nearly every monster can be found in the forest. Watch out
- New Mage Ability: Magic missiles
- New Warrior Ability: Cleave
- New Rogue Ability: Backstab

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- The shops were written a long time ago. This time during the fixes I overhauled almost the whole 
   thing.
- The shopkeepers no longer buy your fists.
- Everything to do with equipping 2 hander was messed up. It works properly now. Yikes
- There were still a few armor selling issues. They should be completely fixed now
- Spelling: Orcs no long "belive" things during the Shrine encounter
- Energy Maximum was not displaying or calculating properly
- Shrine: Negative event on desecrate wasn't doing damage properly

[h1][b]At this point, I feel like the game is a game, rather than a collection of Ideas. The next big push will be adding another dungeon and many things to do, at which point the game will be essentially complete[/b][/h1]


[b][h1]Plan for last major push[/h1][/b]
- Players can make drinks at the bar. These may have interesting effects...
- Players can steal from shops/the bank. Woe be it to those who get caught however...
- Some NPCs in town may have work for an adventurer looking to gain a little extra xp, or a potion or two
- More tavern interactions: Chatting with Locals, Listening to Roderic the bard, Making rousing speeches, Chatting up the bartender
- Random town events
- New Dungeon: The Cave
- Much more developed forest
- Lots of Bug fixes, obvs

notes.title: Necromancer's Mansion
notes.content:
[h1][b]The Necromancer's mansion is now open[/b][/h1]

With the savage orc dead, something has to fill the power vacuum.

Enter... the Necromancer. He has been stealing villagers, alive and dead, for horrible experiments.

Storm his Mansion and put an end to the threat to Marburgh once and for all!


[b]5 new enemies[/b]
Necromancer 
Ghoul
Skeleton
Zombie
Rat

[b]Randomized dungeons with 6 new special rooms, 3 new generic rooms[/b]
Plenty more opportunities to explore with new encounters and deadly traps

[b]Consumable Items[/b]

[b]Craftable Boss Weapons[/b]
Well, one so far (only really one boss of note before Necromancer) but the functionality is now in there! WOO!


[h1][b]And bug fixes, oh the bug fixes!!![/b][/h1]
I still found game breaking bugs in the code up to the Savage Orc. Did you know that you could sell your cloth armor forever? And that you couldn't equip armor when you bought it? I sure didn't.
Well you can now. 





[b]In the next Update (Schedule posted earlier) I plan to address the fact that the town feels a little... I dunno, empty and lifeless? And that was BEFORE the Necromancer....[/b]

notes.title: Dec 11 2020
notes.content:
[b][h1]Necromancer's Mansion[/h1][/b]

The third dungeon, with substantially more random elements as well as 5 new enemies will be released at 9:00 M.S.T.

This required a fairly massive overhaul to the base code, as a good chunk of it was created when I had been programming for less than half a year. I'm hoping the next push will require less 2 AM nights.

The content is in but I want to spend some time balancing and bug fixing (and making dinner) before I push it 


 [b][h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][/b]
Over the course of putting the new dungeon in, I found a [b]plethora[/b] of bugs that needed to be addressed. 

So I'm also just pushing all the fixes I've made now.

- Dungeon now resets basic rooms every day, always was intended
- You can no longer kill the first boss over and over
- You can no longer talk to the villagers in the tavern after gaining access to the 2nd dungeon

- Defend 
    - No longer means you take 0 damage
    - Now significantly increase your chance to not be hit
-Shield
    -If your mage shield is on, you will negate a special attack at the cost of energy. Always was intended
   
- Changed the way search room calculates rewards

- Assortment of small UI color or Grammar fixes

- The UI now properly updates what is happening at all times during combat, even while stunned.
- A few other, small combat UI bugs

Content added that won't be implemented till Friday when I release new Dungeon (That mostly caused this bug fixing patch)

   Zombies, Rats, Ghouls, Skeletons, Necromancer
